newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania leftist chief hails Greek socialist win.
newsitem.headline: Albania leftist chief hails Greek socialist win.

text.p: Albania's jailed leftist leader Fatos Nano welcomed the victory of Greece's socialists in a general election, saying the win would strengthen ties between the two parties, Albania's socialist daily said on Tuesday.
The Albanian Socialist Party leader told newly-elected Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis in a telegram that he was sure the election result would lead to closer cooperation between the two parties.
Albania's right-wing government has so far made no official comment on the elections, although relations between the two Balkan neighbours have improved significantly in the past year.

Nano was jailed in 1994 on charges of embezzlement during his brief stint as prime minister in 1991 and has three more years to serve. International human rights groups have called for his release, claiming that his trial was flawed.
The Socialist Party accuses the government of President Sali Berisha of holding Nano in detention for political reasons.
